item.title: The MIMIC-III-Ext-PPG dataset
item.description: A new dataset, named MIMIC-III-Ext-PPG, has recently been released. The dataset is designed to be a benchmark dataset with which to develop and test PPG models and algorithms. The data were extracted from the larger MIMIC-III dataset, which contains data from critically-ill patients in hospital. The dataset contains 30-second segments of PPG signals, alongside reference parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, and respiratory rate. It also contains other simultaneous physiological signals where available, such as ECG and invasive blood pressure signals.
